title: KUNG MACH X with Shimano UT, 7.2 kg
notes: Brand post presenting the MACH X as a lightweight climbing race bike: 7.2 kg complete, T1000 high-modulus carbon claim, Shimano UT group and matte finish. In a public reply on 20 July 2026 the brand account answered CNY 16,999 to a price question. Size and weighing basis are not stated.

capture.scope: Archived public post; the selected photos were reviewed from the original files, which remain outside Git.
